beats.event: Peter Pan listens at the Darling nursery, loses his shadow
Peter returns; Wendy sews his shadow back on
Peter invites Wendy to Neverland to mother the Lost Boys
Wendy and her brothers fly with Peter to Neverland
Pirate cannon fires; Tootles nearly kills Wendy with arrow
Acorn pendant deflects the arrow; Wendy survives
Lost Boys build a little house for Wendy in the trees
Adventures; Peter rescues Tiger Lily at Mermaids' Lagoon
Wendy asks Peter's feelings; he says 'devoted son'
Homesick Wendy and the boys are captured by Captain Hook
Hook poisons Peter's medicine while he sleeps
Tinker Bell drinks the poison to save Peter
Children's belief in fairies revives Tinker Bell
Peter boards Hook's ship mimicking the crocodile's tick
Peter kicks Hook to the waiting crocodile; pirates defeated
Wendy and brothers sail the captured ship back to London
Mrs Darling adopts the Lost Boys; Peter refuses to stay
A year later Peter has forgotten Tinker Bell and Hook
